case: Fleet Disruption & Voyage Recovery Intelligence Workbench
description: Formal definition of the core business concepts, their hierarchical relationships, and the semantic rules governing their interaction.

nodes.label: Vessel
nodes.description: A physical ship operating under MeridianBlue management.

nodes.label: Voyage
nodes.description: A scheduled commercial journey between ports.

nodes.label: Constraint
nodes.description: A limitation or requirement affecting a voyage (Port, CMMS, Cargo, Weather).

nodes.label: PolicyRule
nodes.description: A governance rule extracted from the Fleet Policy Repository.

nodes.label: RecoveryOption
nodes.description: A proposed course of action to mitigate a disruption.

relationships.description: Links a vessel to its current or historical voyages.
Links a voyage or option to the constraints it must satisfy.
Links a policy rule to the options it governs.
Links the Master to the option they have explicitly authorized.
